title: The Last Morning of Pompeii
description: A normal morning in a busy Roman town, hours before Vesuvius buried it.

scenes.narration: This city has about eighteen hours left, and nobody here knows it.
scenes.image_prompt: bustling ancient Roman street in Pompeii, open shops and townspeople, green Mount Vesuvius in the background, bright morning sun

scenes.narration: It's 79 CE. Pompeii is a busy Roman town of ten to twenty thousand people.
scenes.image_prompt: Pompeii forum crowded with Roman merchants and citizens, temple columns, colourful painted walls

scenes.narration: Bakers pull bread from stone ovens. Some of these loaves will be found almost two thousand years later.
scenes.image_prompt: Roman baker pulling round loaves of bread from a stone oven, flour mills, warm firelight

scenes.narration: Around midday, Vesuvius explodes. A column of ash and rock shoots over thirty kilometres into the sky.
scenes.image_prompt: massive eruption column rising from Mount Vesuvius above the Roman town of Pompeii, people in the street looking up in shock

scenes.narration: Pumice rains down for hours. Roofs start to collapse under the weight.
scenes.image_prompt: grey pumice stones raining down on Roman rooftops, darkened sky, people covering heads with pillows

scenes.narration: Many people flee toward the sea. Those who stay face something far worse.
scenes.image_prompt: crowds of Romans fleeing toward the coast with carts, ash-filled dark sky, boats on rough sea

scenes.narration: Early next morning, a surge of superheated gas and ash races down the mountain and buries the town.
scenes.image_prompt: glowing pyroclastic cloud rushing down the slopes of Vesuvius toward Pompeii at dawn, apocalyptic scale

scenes.narration: Pompeii stayed hidden for almost 1,700 years. Would you have run, or stayed? Tell me below.
scenes.image_prompt: excavated ruins of Pompeii today with Vesuvius behind, golden evening light, tourists in the distance
